lead_headline: Subscriber net surges to +4 yesterday on lowest weekly churn in months as 15-day citation blackout stretches media silence

restaurant.blurb: 4 new leads: Peach & Jack's Bar & Grill replaces The Pearl in Capitol Hill, 85°C Bakery Cafe preps Colorado's first location (Aurora), Dairy Queen closures confirmed (Westminster, Littleton). Closures: Wellness Sushi, Falafel King, Syrup Cherry Creek (16 years).

liquor.blurb: Zero applications Thursday — fourth consecutive day without new filings as post-purge baseline solidifies. No status changes, no removals. Week total holds at 2 applications vs. prior week's 267 (administrative anomaly). Normal 5-8 weekly cadence confirmed as liquor board returns to standard processing rhythm after last week's backlog dump. Two-week pattern locked: Week 1 cleared multi-month queue, Week 2 resumes business-as-usual filing pace.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Thursday extends citation drought to 16 consecutive days — BusinessDen's longest monitored silence on record. All-time total frozen at 1,167 mentions from 111 sources. Past 30 days: 68 mentions (down from 86 yesterday as early-August citations roll off). 16-day blackout now definitively exceeds every prior holiday gap, summer lull, and editorial pause in outlet's tracking history — signals structural syndication collapse, monitoring system failure, or fundamental shift in industry citation patterns. No comparable precedent in multi-year dataset.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +4 yesterday (7 new, 3 canceled) as Wednesday holds acquisition gains despite modest churn uptick. MTD climbs to +16 (+0.8/day) while 90-day net reaches +87. Past 7 days: +34 net (51 new, 17 canceled) vs. prior week's −16 — clean 50-subscriber reversal powered by churn discipline (17 vs. 39 cancellations) and accelerating new-subscriber flow (51 vs. 23). Recent fortnight bifurcates cleanly: Week 1 bled −16 on heavy attrition, Week 2 gains +34 as cancellations drop 56% and acquisition pace doubles. August momentum builds as month escapes early drag — YTD trend (+233, +1.0/day) confirms structural health beneath weekly volatility.
